_doc: Task 48: the questions the game puts to the player's character (PlayerPrompt). Each type has titles, and lines per VOICE (warm, formal, shy, bold: chosen from how well the two know each other and their traits, never stated). {name} the asker, {their}/{name}/{them} pronouns of the asker, {place}, {amount}, {why} a real reason. Options have several label variants and a hint that says what the answer DOES (never a prediction). No relationship words in any text. The same line is not used twice in a row for the same pair, and not again until most others were used.

why: People are getting together at {place}.
A few friends are meeting up.
There is food and music at {place}.
There is a get-together at {place}.

warm: {name} caught you with a big grin: "We're doing something this evening. {why} Say you'll come."
"Don't say no," {name} says. "{why} It would not be the same without you."
{name} has saved you a seat. {why} Coming?
"I was hoping you'd be free," {name} says. "{why}"
formal: {name} has sent a note: "{why} You would be very welcome."
"I would like to invite you," {name} writes. "{why}"
An invitation from {name}. {why} Will you attend?
{name} asks politely whether you can come. {why}
shy: {name} hesitates. "Um. {why} You don't have to..."
"I wasn't sure whether to ask," {name} mumbles. "{why}"
{name} shuffles a little. "{why} Only if you want to."
A small, nervous message from {name}: "{why} Maybe?"
bold: {name} doesn't wait: "{why} I'm counting you in."
{name} grins: "{why} Say yes before I make you."

hints: you are away at the party for a few hours
you stay where you are; {name} will not mind much
you skip it; it is a small thing

why: I have been thinking about you a lot.
I want to stop pretending this is nothing.
I would like it to be real.
I can't keep it in any more.

warm: {name} takes your hand. "{why} Make it official with me?"
"I've been wanting to ask," {name} says softly. "{why} Will you be mine?"
{name} smiles and looks at you. "{why} Shall we say it out loud?"
"No more guessing," {name} says. "{why} Yes?"
formal: {name} clears {their} throat. "{why} Would you consider seeing me properly?"
"May I ask something personal?" {name} says. "{why}"
{name} speaks carefully: "{why} Would you like to make this a real thing?"
"I would like to be honest with you," says {name}. "{why}"
shy: {name} stares at the floor. "{why} I mean... would you...?"
"I'm no good at this," {name} says. "{why} Maybe we could be... together?"
{name} blushes. "{why} Is that all right?"
"Um," says {name}. "{why} Please say something."
bold: "Let's stop dancing around it," {name} says. "{why} Be with me."
{name} steps closer. "{why} I'm not asking twice."

hints: you start seeing each other for real
{name} will wait, but things cool a little

why: I want this settled.
I am sure about you.
I don't want to share you with a maybe.
I want a real commitment.

warm: "I love being with you," {name} says. "{why} Will you be my partner?"
{name} leans on you. "{why} Let's make it permanent?"
"Stay," {name} says gently. "{why} Be my partner."
{name} laughs a little nervously. "{why} So? Partners?"
formal: {name} says: "{why} I would like us to commit to each other."
"I've thought about this carefully," {name} says. "{why}"
{name} asks: "{why} Would you agree to be my partner?"
"There is something I'd like to settle," says {name}. "{why}"
shy: {name} fidgets. "{why} Do you... want to be partners?"
"I rehearsed this," {name} admits. "{why} It's gone out of my head."
{name} whispers: "{why} Would you?"
"It's a lot to ask," {name} says. "{why}"
bold: "I'm done with maybe," {name} says. "{why} Partners, starting now."
"I know what I want," says {name}. "{why} You."
{name} grins. "{why} Say yes, you know you want to."

hints: you two commit to each other
{name} will be hurt but will wait

why: I have been carrying a ring.
I have decided.
I can't picture anyone else.
I want it all.

warm: {name} gets down on one knee. "{why} Will you marry me?"
"I want every day with you," {name} says. "{why} Marry me?"
{name} holds out a ring, eyes shining. "{why} Will you?"
"Say you will," {name} whispers. "{why}"
formal: {name} says gravely: "{why} I ask you to marry me."
"I would be honoured if you would marry me," {name} says. "{why}"
{name} offers a ring. "{why} Will you accept?"
"I have a proposal," says {name}. "{why}"
shy: {name}'s hands shake. "{why} Would you... marry me?"
"I can't believe I'm doing this," {name} says. "{why}"
{name} swallows. "{why} Please?"
"Um, will you?" {name} manages. "{why}"
bold: {name} slaps a ring in your hand. "{why} Well?"
"I'm not waiting any longer," says {name}. "{why} Marry me."

I want no more waiting.
I have everything ready.

"Let's do it," {name} says. "{why}"
{name} takes your hands. "{why} Shall we?"
"I can't wait," {name} says. "{why}"

{name} asks: "{why} Shall we proceed?"
"If you are ready," says {name}, "{why}"
shy: {name} blushes. "{why} Only if you want to."
"Maybe soon?" {name} says. "{why}"
{name} murmurs: "{why} Is today all right?"
"I'd understand if not," {name} says. "{why}"

I want a baby.
I feel ready for a family.

warm: {name} says softly: "{why} Shall we try?"
"I think about it all the time," {name} says. "{why}"
{name} smiles. "{why} What do you think?"
"A little one," {name} says. "{why}"

{name} asks: "{why} Is this something you want?"

"I don't know how to say this," {name} says. "{why}"
{name} looks away. "{why} Maybe?"
"It's silly," {name} says. "{why}"
bold: {name} doesn't hide it: "{why} I want to try. Now."

why: I am out of work and the rent is due.
I haven't eaten properly in days.
I have run out of money before the week ends.
I am {amount} coins short and have nowhere else to ask.

warm: {name} looks tired. "{why} Could you lend me {amount} coins? I'll pay you back."
"I hate asking," {name} says. "{why} Can you spare {amount} coins?"
{name} squeezes your arm. "{why} {amount} coins would get me through."
"You're the only one I'd ask," {name} says. "{why} {amount} coins?"
formal: {name} asks: "{why} Might I borrow {amount} coins?"
"I am embarrassed to ask," {name} says. "{why} {amount} coins would help."
{name} states the problem plainly. "{why} Could you lend {amount} coins?"
"A loan of {amount} coins," {name} says. "{why}"
shy: {name} can hardly meet your eye. "{why} {amount} coins... if you can."
"Sorry," {name} says. "{why} I wouldn't ask, but {amount} coins..."
{name} mumbles: "{why} Would {amount} coins be all right?"
"I know it's a lot," {name} says. "{why}"
bold: {name} doesn't dress it up: "{why} Lend me {amount}."
"Look, {amount} coins," says {name}. "{why} You'll get it back."

you hand it over; {name} will remember it
